page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-lc1m2.small is a burstable virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features a single x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor core running at 2.5 GHz with 1 vCPU and 1 thread per core. The system is equipped with 2.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps. The CPU includes support for AVX, AVX512F, AES cryptography, and FMA instructions.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tier, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU metrics scoring 1042.98. Memory bandwidth is measured at 73.95 GB/sec for small cached blocks, dropping to 8.7 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, and 7.34 GB/sec for write operations. Passmark CPU and memory scores are 1239.52 and 653.25 respectively. In database and application tests, the instance achieves 1.12 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and 0.86 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

This instance offers a highly cost-efficient profile for entry-level, low-utilization workloads where continuous CPU performance is not required. Due to its burstable CPU allocation and limited memory capacity, it is best suited for lightweight tasks such as basic web serving, small-scale development or testing environments, simple microservices, and low-traffic background processes.
